Game Overview

Veggie Friends puts players into a educational experience centered on join cheerful veggie pals on an educational adventure. Explore vibrant worlds, gathering and sorting vegetables while uncovering fun facts. Boost memory and coordination with captivating challenges, as playful voices and colorful graphics make discovering healthy foods an engaging experience for all ages.
